Crypto billionaire Justin Sun has published a sensational story about his alleged relationship with Chinese actress Jing Tian—complete with luxury trips, millions in payments, a $50 million request, and a real lawsuit over more than RMB 30 million.

But the bigger story may be Justin Sun himself. From TRON and crypto exchanges to Warren Buffett’s lunch, a $6.2 million banana and a trip to space, this episode looks at how Sun turned attention into one of his most valuable assets.
